evidence.reason: revalidated: PR #1489 published fix hardens deploy-controller record-dir handling so a symlinked --record-dir is refused by preflight instead of journals being written through the link (absolute path settled without resolving the final component). Verified against current origin/main e181cf0e87337992289ed3980c34e0563389648c: the hardening persists in stronger form - absolute_record_dir() helper documents and applies exactly that rule (ops/deploy-controller.py:194-198), record_preflight() explicitly refuses a symlinked record directory (L322-323), requires an existing directory (L324-325) and 0700 mode (L326) under later refactors. Canonical finding delivered; PR #1489 MERGED with published head ancestor of merge.
